steps.s1d: Sign up with your email and a verification code. It takes about a minute.
steps.s2d: Send USDT to your own deposit address on ERC20, TRC20 or BSC (BEP20). The minimum is 1 USDT.

safe.title: Funds and security
safe.sub: Only what the system actually does
safe.s1d: Every account has its own USDT deposit address and deposits are credited automatically after on-chain confirmation. The private keys of deposit addresses are not stored on our servers.
safe.s2d: Withdrawals only go to addresses on your whitelist; a newly added address can be used after 24 hours.
safe.s3d: Every withdrawal starts with a cooling-off period (you can cancel during it) and is then reviewed by a person; large withdrawals are also held for a while after approval.
safe.s4d: Withdrawals require identity verification (KYC), so a stolen login alone cannot move your funds out.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Which deposit networks are supported? What is the minimum?
faq.a1: Only USDT, on ERC20 (Ethereum), TRC20 (TRON) or BSC (BEP20). The minimum deposit is 1 USDT; smaller transfers are not credited. Choose the network carefully: transfers on the wrong network or of other tokens cannot be recovered.
faq.q2: How long does a withdrawal take?
faq.a2: After you submit a withdrawal there is a 2-hour cooling-off period (you can cancel during it), then a manual review, and after approval it is sent on chain. Withdrawals of 3,000 USDT or more are held for another 6 hours after approval. Arrival also depends on how fast the blockchain confirms.
faq.q3: What do I need to withdraw?
faq.a3: You need to complete identity verification (KYC) and you can only withdraw to whitelisted addresses; a new address becomes usable 24 hours after it is added. Withdrawal fees and limits are shown on the withdrawal page.
faq.q4: How do I use it on my phone?
faq.a4: Open the client in your phone browser to sign up and use it; no app download is needed. You can also add it to your home screen to open it like an app and receive alerts.
